cd /app/work && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import nasty, check as C
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(); bad=0; worst={}
reqs=[]
for i in range(30):
    r=nasty.symmetric(i)
    for cm in r['commodities']: cm['demand']=8
    reqs.append(r)
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
print("%.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), p.stderr.decode()[:200])
for i,r in enumerate(reqs):
    L=C.build(r); resp=json.loads(p.stdout.decode().splitlines()[i])
    try:
        st = C.check_response(r,resp,L); c[st[0]]+=1
        for j,nm in enumerate(("col","ymax","gap")):
            if st[1+j] > worst.get(nm,-1): worst[nm]=st[1+j]
        if st[0]=="optimal" and i<3: print("  mlu",st[4],"magy",st[5],"magq",st[6])
    except Exception as e:
        bad+=1; print("FAIL",i,repr(e), json.dumps(resp)[:150])
print(c,"bad",bad,"worst",{k:"%.3g"%v for k,v in worst.items()})
PYEOF
